question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret
solution:
The correct answer is** Poignant.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **Here ***POIGNANT*** means evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret.

 
 
• ***Eg.*** It is especially* poignant* that he died on the day before the wedding.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's just look at the meaning of other given words:

 
• **Pungent** means smelling or tasting very strong or sharp

 
 
• ***Eg.*** I sat down toa wonderfully *pungent *Turkish coffee.
 
 
 
• **Impactful***** ***means having a powerful effect on a person or situation.
 
 
• ***Eg. ***I'm trying to use my time in a more *impactfu*l way.
 
 
 
• **Unaffecting** means not causing a strong emotion; especially sadness
 
 
• ***Eg.*** Watching the play is a disappointingly *unaffecting* experience.
